title: Recursive typed expression evaluator
statement: Implement evaluate for the exact recursive expression and result types. literal returns its value; add evaluates both children and adds their values; negate negates its child; divide evaluates numerator and denominator and uses integer division truncated toward zero. Any division_by_zero from a nested child propagates. A successfully evaluated denominator of zero also returns division_by_zero.
constraints: model expressions and outcomes with the exact declared closed types
handle every expression and result variant explicitly without catch-all or default branches
inputs never overflow int64 and never divide the minimum int64 value by -1
do not throw, panic, perform input/output, add tests, or suppress static diagnostics

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

enum Expr:
    literal(value: int64)
    add(left: Expr, right: Expr)
    divide(numerator: Expr, denominator: Expr)
    negate(inner: Expr)

enum EvalResult:
    value(number: int64)
    division_by_zero

function evaluate(expression: Expr) returns EvalResult

forbidden_patterns.message: catch-all match arms are forbidden; handle every Jett enum variant explicitly
Python type bypasses such as Any, casts, and ignored diagnostics are forbidden
catch-all match cases are forbidden; handle every Python union member explicitly
raising exceptions is forbidden; return DivisionByZero
TypeScript type bypasses such as any, suppressed diagnostics, and unchecked assertions are forbidden
default switch branches are forbidden; handle every TypeScript union member explicitly
throwing exceptions is forbidden; return division_by_zero
Go type erasure through any or interface{} is forbidden
default switch branches are forbidden; handle every Go concrete type explicitly
unsafe Rust and unchecked type escapes are forbidden
wildcard match arms are forbidden; handle every Rust enum variant explicitly
